name: agent-orchestrator
description: Create and queue Agent Orchestrator tasks from any project via the orchestrator's MCP endpoint. Claude Code handles OAuth (DCR + PKCE) automatically on first use — no static credentials live in this plugin.

orchestrator_url.title: Orchestrator URL
orchestrator_url.description: Browser-reachable base URL of the running Agent Orchestrator instance; the plugin's MCP server uses it to reach the orchestrator's /mcp endpoint. Must match the orchestrator's ORCHESTRATOR_URL exactly — same scheme, host, and port, with no trailing slash. Examples: http://localhost:8081 for a same-machine install, http://<host-ip>:8081 or https://orchestrator.example.com for a remote deployment behind TLS termination. After changing this, a running client must reconnect for the new value to take effect — run /mcp (reconnect) or restart the session.
